raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 8  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Theodore Roosevelt's spouse was Alice Hathaway Lee Roosevelt. While the Jenkins Orphanage Band did play at Theodore Roosevelt's inaugural parade in 1905, his spouse at the time was Edith Roosevelt, not Alice Hathaway Lee, who had passed away in 1884. The error occurred because the Planner failed to verify the timeline of Theodore Roosevelt's marriages and incorrectly associated him with his first wife instead of his second wife, Edith Roosevelt, who was his spouse during the time of the 1905 inaugural parade.
